DiskSpaceUtilizationWarning / DiskSpaceU._dashboard: 10. General Windows Host Metrics Overview ($host is an instance host:port)

High memory utilization._dashboard: 2. Windows Server Details Dashboard - With Services
High memory utilization._shape: Zabbix/email-sourced: '<description> (<threshold>) - <HOST>'. No [FIRING:n], no label group; the host is the trailing token and lands in {host}.
High memory utilization._why_resolve: Panel 21 filters on $instance ('10.199.1.11:9182'), while the alert only names the host ('STG-SVC120'). Setting $hostname alone leaves $instance empty and the gauge renders a green 'N/A'. The resolve block looks the instance up in Prometheus instead of guessing it.

HostCPUUtilizationCritical._dashboard: VMware ESXi — $esxhost is the ESXi host_name
HostCPUUtilizationCritical._why_label_2: The alert names TWO FQDNs and only the FIRST is the subject: label 2 is the ESXi host (series label host_name), label 3 is the vmware_exporter that scrapes vCenter (series label instance). Verified against a live series 2026-08-31 — graphing label 3 would chart the wrong machine entirely.
